---
title: "Dynamic Granger causality under the USMCA"
---

**Status:** Research in progress.

This study examines episodic predictive relationships between exchange-rate returns and short-term interest-rate differentials among Canada, Mexico, and the United States.

**Empirical approach:** Evolving-window Granger causality tests and lag-augmented vector autoregressions.

Granger causality is interpreted as predictive content, not as a structural causal effect.
